model CentralOrgUnit {
  id                 String   @id @default(uuid())
  type               String
  name               String
  code               String?
  oeKey              Int?     @map("oe_key")
  parentId           String?  @map("parent_id")
  managerSapNumber   Int?     @map("manager_sap_number")
  managerEmployeeId  String?  @map("manager_employee_id")
  active             Boolean
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  parent    CentralOrgUnit?  @relation("CentralOrgUnitHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  children  CentralOrgUnit[] @relation("CentralOrgUnitHierarchy")
  employees CentralEmployee[]
  aliases   OrgUnitAlias[]

  @@index([parentId])
  @@map("central_org_units")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/central/schema.prisma lines 64-88
model CentralEmployee {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  sapNumber Int      @unique @map("sap_number")
  firstName String?  @map("first_name")
  surname   String?  @map("surname")
  name      String
  email     String?  @map("email")
  orgUnitId String?  @map("org_unit_id")
  active    Boolean
  personnelSource String @default("INTERNAL") @map("personnel_source")
  externalType String @default("NONE") @map("external_type")
  storageScope String @default("CENTRAL") @map("storage_scope")
  personnelLifecycleState String @default("ACTIVE") @map("personnel_lifecycle_state")
  centralSyncState String @default("ACTIVE") @map("central_sync_state")
  centralSyncError String? @map("central_sync_error")
  centralSyncAttemptedAt DateTime? @map("central_sync_attempted_at")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  orgUnit CentralOrgUnit? @relation(fields: [orgUnitId], references: [id], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)
  lendingAssignments CentralLendingAssignment[] @relation("CentralLendingEmployee")

  @@index([orgUnitId])
  @@map("central_employees")
}
// copied from planning-tool/backend/prisma/central/schema.prisma lines 94-114
model CentralLendingAssignment {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  localAssignmentId String   @unique @map("local_assignment_id")
  employeeSapNumber Int      @map("employee_sap_number")
  sourceUnitId      String   @map("source_unit_id")
  targetUnitId      String   @map("target_unit_id")
  managerScopeId    String   @map("manager_scope_id")
  fteShare          Decimal  @map("fte_share")
  validFrom         DateTime @map("valid_from")
  validTo           DateTime? @map("valid_to")
  status            String
  revision          Int      @default(1)
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  employee CentralEmployee @relation("CentralLendingEmployee", fields: [employeeSapNumber], references: [sapNumber], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([employeeSapNumber, status])
  @@index([sourceUnitId, targetUnitId, status])
  @@map("central_lending_assignments")
}
